title: Maximum site cover
text: Development on each site does not exceed the maximum site cover percentages of Table 3.1a.

replaces.note: open space minimum replaced by site cover maximum; +5 points at every code R2-R25
open space column inverted to site cover

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Verified fixture rule. R30 and above (and R100-SL) return NOT_APPLICABLE through the null table row: 'Site cover does not apply to R30 and above'. Definitions differ from Part B open space (register ch2-037), so the +5 point relaxation is smaller when patios are built.
